_comment: Fish Audio cast for Naruto What-If. Pin after listening to build/copycat/naruto-auditions/reel/: python -m copycat.cast_director --franchise naruto --pick NARUTO=B KAKASHI=A  (or a voice id). Pinned entries survive --refresh. Each role: top-level fields are the chosen settings; options A/B/C are the reel candidates with their tuned settings.

NARUTO.title: Confident Young Man

target.look: boyish, bright, raspy, loud, fast, cocky-but-warm

NARUTO.rationale: Confident Young Man: median F0 236.4 Hz (target 210-270), 208.8 wpm (target 175-240); distance 0.031 via base

CLONE.title: Confident Young Man
CLONE.rationale: Same voice id as NARUTO; +6% rate and +3% pitch so crowds of clones read as him.
